reviews.title: One peanut. Perfect.
reviews.body: I was promised one peanut and I received exactly one peanut. Consistency is rare these days.

reviews.title: Arrived (eventually)
reviews.body: The flight was delayed, then early, then delayed again. I did arrive somewhere, which was nice.

reviews.title: Landed in the garden
reviews.body: We landed in the garden at Scraggy House. The roses did not enjoy it. I did.

reviews.title: Where is my bag
reviews.body: My bag has seen more of the world than I have. It sends postcards. I would like it back.

reviews.title: Engines MAY be working
reviews.body: I ticked the box accepting that the engines may be working. I now understand why that box exists.

reviews.title: Helped, sort of
reviews.body: The JOELMOBILE took me to a gate. Not my gate, but a gate. Joel was very confident about it.
